governing_decision: At maximum legitimate Monk progression without worn gear, every genuinely comparable noncombat capability should be 80-90% of the optimized appropriately-geared specialist's equivalent output; use 85% by default. Sea Dragon Luck is explicitly 80%.
applies_to: Directly comparable personal noncombat capabilities, not mandatory grants of class-locked blood/lich/dragon physiology; separate combat/health/healing/boss balance. A special player's gear/equipment restriction must be honored by source.

formula.specialist_full: F_S = measured(native_specialist + permanent_skill_ranks + legal_gear_enchants_Apotheosis_gems_Curios + relevant_buffs), honoring the actual engine's additive/multiplicative operations; not simple sum of tooltips
formula.monk_target: F_M(capped) = target_ratio * F_S(fully_optimized_appropriate_tier); subtract innate Monk + common Core Skills contribution to determine the remaining Monk-specific skill budget
formula.monk_rank_curve: For a proposed N-rank incremental Monk skill: additional_monk_at_rank(r) = max(0, target_ratio*F_S - F_M_before_this_skill)*r/N for 0<=r<=N, recalibrate nonlinearly for discrete level, proc, range, claim and event-capped traits
formula.when_baseline_zero: Absolute stat units, explicit nonzero reference or observable output distribution required; never multiply 0 vanilla Luck by an arbitrary percent and call that progression
formula.spell_and_gear: All source-specific final attributes/modifiers must be measured in legitimate endgame gear before adding skill effects; no magic industrial tanks or passive machine budgets

calibration_state: NO VERIFIED NUMERIC X VALUES YET. The 100-point example is a normalized index only and does not represent raw Minecraft Luck or an actual equipped Sea Dragon.

luck_example.note: This example only demonstrates how to back-solve per-rank Monk values from FINAL Sea with full gear. Real Luck attribute/loot calculations are source-specific and will not share these invented index units.
